events.text: {"verdict":"proceed","decision":"Build T-498 end to end in cloud/funnel/worker.js. 1) Add `crm.owners` to the funnel config schema and to kits/funnel/build-config: a map from stage to owner, filled from outputs/D1.16-d1-crm/owners.md. Store each CRM's user id: GHL userId, HubSpot ownerId, Zoho owner id, and the user name for the built-in CRM. 2) Add a helper, ownerFor(k, c, prevOwner), that applies the D1.16 rules. The setter owns Form Filled to Eval Call Scheduled, the closer owns Qualified to Payment Completed, and the coordinator owns Onboarding and Delivery. No Show and Unqualified keep the previous owner. 3) In crmPush, set the owner: GHL assignedTo on the contact and the opportunity; HubSpot hubspot_owner_id on the contact and the deal; Zoho Owner on the Lead. In the built-in CRM, write an owner column (schema.sql migration). 4) Add a sim test for each adapter: a contact moving from booked to the closer stage changes owner. 5) Run the tests, log the evidence and move the task to review.","why":"Queue task assigned to Claude, with no outside input needed. The crmPush adapters for GHL, HubSpot and Zoho already exist at worker.js:634-710 but set no owner. The D1.16 step 9 owners.md defines the stage-owner rules. The sim vendors cover the tests.","outward_ok":["commit and push the worker, schema and kit changes to our own repo","deploy the updated funnel Worker to our own demo/test funnels after tests pass"],"reassign_to_claude":true,"adi_input":null}
